vulnerability.name: USN-5686-2
vulnerability.description: USN-5686-1 fixed several vulnerabilities in Git. This update provides the corresponding fix for CVE-2022-39260 on Ubuntu 16.04 ESM.  Original advisory details:   Kevin Backhouse discovered that Git incorrectly handled certain command  strings. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a crash or  arbitrary code execution.

statements.status_notes: Git could be made to crash or run programs as your login if it received specially crafted input. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
